newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance to merge with carrier.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance to merge with carrier.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to merge with United WATS Inc, an inter-exchange carrier for businesses.
The merger will involve a pooling of interests with United WATS, which is based in Kansas City, the company said.
Network President and Chief Executive Michael Ross said the merger is the company's largest acquisition in its 17 years.

Ross added that United WATS will bring to the combined companies a longstanding relationship with Sprint Corp and MCI Communications Corp, which "should open new windows of opportunity. ... This will give (Network Long Distance's) existing sales channels direct access to two very prominent carriers; and it will allow (Network) to approach hundreds of Sprint and MCI-based resellers that it would not have previously targeted as potential merger and acquisition candidates."
